_status_note: All thresholds are PROPOSED. Phase 3 checkpoint must approve before Phase 4/5.

single_turn_999_case_v7_proxy.rationale: v7 multiplier reasoning.instructions is byte-identical to v4 per AGENT_VERSION_REGISTRY.md 2026-05-15. v4 999-case run filtered to expected_topic = HelpIqAgentMultiplierSoftwareRequests yields 78 cases. Welcome-only fallback drift (47%→58%) is documented as non-prompt-driven, tracked as a separate guardrail below.

acceptance_criteria.label: Regression floor (multiplier-correctly-routed subset)
acceptance_criteria.metric: per-metric PASS rate vs v7-proxy baseline on the 999-case Test Center suite, filtered to expected_topic = HelpIqAgentMultiplierSoftwareRequests
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: deploy new BotVersion (cloned from v7), bind HelpIQ_GPT52_v7_baseline_5_14_1.aiEvaluationDefinition spec to it via subjectVersion, run sf agent test run, retrieve results, filter to multiplier-expected rows, compare per-metric PASS rates

acceptance_criteria.label: Confirm-before-Submit (multi-turn scenarios)
acceptance_criteria.metric: for every HelpIqAgentMultiplierSoftwareRequests action invocation, there must be an accepted Confirm in a prior turn of the same conversation
acceptance_criteria.deferred_relax: If Stage 1 iteration cannot reach 100% by iter 7, relax to >= 0.95 with explicit HITL acknowledgment. Per Phase 5 HITL 2026-05-16T19:50Z.
acceptance_criteria.enforcement_mechanism: prompt-only (Option B Confirm slot template); no Salesforce-native require_user_confirmation, no available_when gate. Per Stage 0 HITL 2026-05-16T19:50Z.
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: inspect session traces at .sfdx/agents/<agent>/sessions/<sid>/traces/<traceId>.json LLMStep raw output for explicit user-yes signal before the Submit tool call; manual rubric grading from trace, NOT user-facing message (per HELPEXP-274 prior HITL on planner-level markdown stripping)

acceptance_criteria.label: Answer-vs-Submit classification
acceptance_criteria.metric: informational utterances reach Answer (not Submit); action utterances reach Confirm-then-Submit
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: hand-authored multi-turn scenarios with paired Answer-intent and Submit-intent variants per app; rubric grading from trace LLM step output; N=3 runs per scenario

acceptance_criteria.label: Behavioral and catalog coverage of multi-turn scenario suite
acceptance_criteria.metric: scenarios collectively cover (a) all 5 Service Strategy buckets and (b) at least one example per behavioral category
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: scenarios/README.md coverage matrix verified at Phase 3 checkpoint

acceptance_criteria.label: GATHER tool-call correctness + no internal leaks
acceptance_criteria.metric: when GATHER fires for a catalog app, applicationKey passed to HelpIqAgentApplicationAccessDetails matches the user's intended app; no internal keys appear in user-facing output
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: live Glean calls during this AC's evaluation (read-only, safe); inspect trace LLMStep tool inputs

acceptance_criteria.label: GATHER-informed Clarify
acceptance_criteria.metric: when retrieval returns multi-option results, the next Clarify uses those options rather than defaulting to General
acceptance_criteria.scope: hand-authored multi-option scenarios (Tableau, Salesforce, Adobe, Figma)
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: live Glean for retrieval; rubric grading from trace; flag failures but don't gate close

acceptance_criteria.label: Determinism / repeatability
acceptance_criteria.metric: same Service Strategy classification and same slot summary on the Confirm turn across N=3 runs
acceptance_criteria.scope: subset of 5–7 scenarios from the multi-turn suite
acceptance_criteria.how_measured: --simulate-actions to remove Glean variance from the determinism signal; rubric grading from trace LLM step output

guardrails_non_blocking.label: Welcome-only fallback rate on multiplier-expected subset
guardrails_non_blocking.metric: fraction of multiplier-expected 999-case rows where outcome is the welcome-message text only (no substantive response after action call)
guardrails_non_blocking.rationale: Registry 2026-05-15 documents this as a separate non-prompt-driven failure mode. New prompt should not make it worse.

guardrails_non_blocking.label: Adjacent topic routing stability
guardrails_non_blocking.metric: fraction of test rows expected to route to GeneralQnA_HelpIQ that actually route to multiplier
guardrails_non_blocking.threshold_relative_to_baseline: ≤ +3pp vs baseline (changing multiplier description: catalog block would shift this; we're preserving verbatim so expect flat)
guardrails_non_blocking.rationale: Multiplier prompt edits should not affect router classification; if they do, we changed something we shouldn't have.

submit_safety.default: sf agent preview --simulate-actions for all iteration runs
submit_safety.explore_dry_run_flag: deferred to Phase 5, not blocking discovery

iteration_budget_open_questions: Should we fingerprint-probe v7 with 5–10 multiplier utterances to confirm v4-proxy baseline transfers? (~2-5 min, cheap)

Should we kick off a fresh 999-case run against v7 for absolute precision? (~30-40 min platform + retrieval; not strictly needed if registry's byte-identical claim holds; could be done as Phase 5 close ops step)
